text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Shinko Windy kept her promise. Without 
biting anyone, she delivered a run that 
surpassed her debut race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, what the spectators were watching 
for wasn't her running, but whether she 
would bite anyone. Frustrated, she laments 
that no one is looking at her true 
ability.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the Trainer said it was a good 
thing, because "she had conquered 
herself." Encouraged by these words, she 
rallied her spirits.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She wants to clear irritating stigmas like 
"coward" and "brute," and instead spread a 
cool kind of "notoriety."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
To overturn public perception, she needed 
to prove her ability on an even bigger 
stage. The next goal was set for the GⅠ 
Japan Dirt Derby.
